message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of skill editing, validation, and epoch-level feedback.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram has a fast editing and validation pipeline across the top and a dashed teal epoch-wise slow/meta-update loop below. At upper left, a DATASET box lists three splits: “Train split: rollout evidence” in green, “Validation split: update gate” in yellow, and “Test split: locked until final report” in gray with a lock icon. A robot labeled “Fixed Agent” points to a blue skill-document icon labeled S_t and “trainable module.” The skill feeds a “Rollout batch” illustrated with trajectory traces and a score, then branches into mini-batches 1, 2, …, K. Each mini-batch points to an “Optimizer model,” which proposes “L atomic edits per mini-batch,” shown as ADD, DEL, and REP operations (add/delete/replace). The repeated minibatches and edit groups are indicated by ellipses. Their outputs enter a purple “Batch-level merge” box that deduplicates and resolves conflicts. The merged edits go to a box that ranks/clips them by edit budget L_t and applies an “LR schedule: decay L_t.” Next, a “Modifier” performs a bounded text update, including a “slow-update field (epoch-only field),” producing candidate skill S_{t+1}. The candidate points to a yellow “Validation gate.” A green arrow labeled “accept” leads from the gate to the blue current-skill document S_{t+1}, which points to “best_skill.md,” labeled “best validated skill.” A red dashed arrow labeled “reject” drops from the gate to a “rejected-edit buffer”; a red dashed feedback path runs from that buffer left and upward into the batch-level merge.\n\nThe lower dashed teal region is titled “EPOCH-WISE SLOW/META UPDATE.” “After one epoch” branches to blue documents for “previous epoch skill” and “current epoch skill.” Each feeds a small trajectory/trace-and-score illustration; the note beneath says “same sample, different skills.” These comparisons feed four stacked outcome boxes: green “improvements,” red “regressions,” red “persistent failures,” and green “stable successes.” Arrows from all four enter a teal “Epoch-wise reflection” box. A dashed teal path labeled “Slow update” runs from reflection upward to the Modifier’s epoch-only slow-update field. Another dashed teal arrow leads from reflection to a purple “Optimizer meta-skill” box, which contains “which edits helped,” “which edits failed,” and “remaining failure patterns.” A dashed teal feedback path from this box runs rightward and upward to the current-skill node, labeled “update future Optimize model calls.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
